description: Localized captions for character stamp messages. Stamp rows store Id_StampText; the stamp selector and chat message widgets use that id to show the caption while the sprite and voice come from the same Stamp row.

ID.simple: Stamp caption text id (row key), e.g. CP_010_STAMP_001.
ID.technical: FName ID of FGameDataTableRow_GameText, used as the FindRow key in the combined GameText array. FGameDataTableRow_Stamp::Id_StampText carries this id; UGameStampListViewItemWidget passes it to SetButtonTextId, and chat stamp requests copy it into FGameStampMessageRequest.TextId before SetTextIdOnly on the message block. The table is loaded as StampTextDataTable_<Language> in slot 6 of the 14-table array. Note that the Stamp row's own Id (row name) is a different key, used for network/message identification and to look up the Stamp row.

Text.simple: The localized stamp caption shown with the stamp icon.
Text.technical: FString row text (+0x10), copied by GetGameText and formatted by FormatText with the usual GLO/DYN/modifier rules; the text block resolves the id when SetButtonTextId/SetTextIdOnly is applied. The stamp's PaperSprite is loaded separately from Stamp.FileName and its voice from Stamp.Id_Voice, so this field is only the caption. Missing rows render empty. All 43 rows are nonempty in every companion language export and no tags were observed in En.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_GameText with 11 exported language variants (43 identical row ids each). Slot 6 in GameTextManager::Tick; Config/DefaultGame.ini:35-45 cooks one variant per language chunk.

Cross-table join: FGameDataTableRow_Stamp provides Id (message payload, GameCommonChatListWidget.cpp:167), FileName (sprite), Id_Voice (voice) and Id_StampText (this table). UGameCommonChatListWidget enumerates StampDataTables into UGameStampListItemData (GameCommonChatListWidget.cpp:44-48).
No stamp-prefix dispatch exists in the text manager; any non-SYS_ id is searched across all 14 GameText tables in fixed order, so collisions with earlier groups would shadow this caption.

Reconstruction caveat: text resolution functions are byte-matched, while FindTextRow/Tick are behaviour-certified (status/functions.json 0x14af290, 0x14c96f0; BEHAV BG03). Content is partial; retail Blueprint-only uses are not asserted.

usages.detail: OnListItemSet sets the stamp selector button text from the Stamp row's Id_StampText.
Copies Stamp.Id_StampText into an inbound stamp message request (alongside FileName and Id_Voice).
ShowStampMessage applies Request.TextId to the stamp message's text block.
Collects StampDataTables rows into list items that expose those rows to the selector and chat widgets.
Loads StampTextDataTable_<Language> into the shared GameText search array.
